listing.name: Dragon Warrior VII — DW7-recomp (danyboy666)
listing.summary: Experimental Dragon Warrior VII source project. Upstream reports the intro, title, menus and name entry; field gameplay, battles and disc 2 remain unfinished or unconfirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA PlayStation Dragon Warrior VII disc 1 of 2, SLUS01206. The second disc ID is not confirmed; check upstream’s current requirements before proceeding beyond disc 1.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Initialize the pinned PSXRecomp and its submodules, generate the game C code from your own USA Dragon Warrior VII disc 1 CUE, then build psx-runtime with CMake and Ninja. Upstream warns that regeneration loses a required correction: apply its documented three generated-code edits or emitter fix before rebuilding. This source project is unfinished; no ready-to-play package has been confirmed.

warnings: Upstream reports the intro, title, main menu and name entry. The opening field, story, battles and remaining overlays are still being developed. A working disc 1 menu does not establish disc 2 or full-game support.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
